defaultViz.description: Deprecated legacy alias of "type" — do not use in new configs. Set "type" to the widget type instead; for a table with a chart toggle use "type": "table" with data.table.chartView ({ "enabled": true, "chartType": "line" }).

gridData.description: Defines the grid layout for the widget. `w` and `h` are required, while `minW`, `minH`, `maxW`, and `maxH` are optional.
